verses.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ’î·yō·wḇ śə·’êṯ mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Job . . . continued his discourse . . .
verses.literalPt: De novo, prosseguiu Jó o seu discurso e disse:

verses.original: חַי־ אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay- ’êl hê·sîr miš·pā·ṭî wə·šad·day hê·mar nap̄·šî
verses.literal: As surely as God lives who has deprived me of justice the Almighty who has embittered my soul
verses.literalPt: Pela vida de Deus, que me tirou o direito, e do Todo-Poderoso, que me amargurou a alma

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כָל־ ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵāl ‘ō·wḏ niš·mā·ṯî ḇî wə·rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah bə·’ap·pî
verses.literal: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils
verses.literalPt: (Pois ainda está em mim a minha vida, e o sopro de Deus, no meu nariz.);

verses.original: אִם־ תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם־ יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tə·ḏab·bê·rə·nāh śə·p̄ā·ṯay ‘aw·lāh ū·lə·šō·w·nî ’im- yeh·geh rə·mî·yāh
verses.literal: my lips will not speak wickedness and my tongue will not utter deceit
verses.literalPt: os meus lábios não falam a injustiça, nem a minha língua profere o engano.

verses.original: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם־ אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד־ אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא־ אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·lî·lāh lî ’im- ’aṣ·dîq ’eṯ·ḵem ‘aḏ- ’eḡ·wā‘ lō- ’ā·sîr tum·mā·ṯî mim·men·nî
verses.literal: I will never say that you are right I will maintain . . . my integrity . . . until I die
verses.literalPt: Não permita Deus que eu vos dê razão. Até que eu morra, não apartarei de mim a minha integridade.

verses.original: בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹֽא־ יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî he·ḥĕ·zaq·tî wə·lō ’ar·pe·hā lō- ye·ḥĕ·rap̄ lə·ḇā·ḇî mî·yā·māy
verses.literal: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go As long as I live my conscience will not accuse me
verses.literalPt: À minha justiça me apegarei e não a largarei. Não reprova o meu coração dia algum da minha vida.

verses.original: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî ḵə·rā·šā‘ ’ō·yə·ḇî ū·miṯ·qō·wm·mî ḵə·‘aw·wāl
verses.literal: May my enemy be like the wicked and my opponent like the unjust
verses.literalPt: Seja como iníquo o meu inimigo, e, como injusto, aquele que se levanta contra mim.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַה־ תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mah- tiq·waṯ ḥā·nêp̄ kî yiḇ·ṣā‘ kî yê·šel ’ĕ·lō·w·ah nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off when God takes away his life
verses.literalPt: Pois qual é a esperança do ímpio quando Deus o corta, quando lhe arrebata a alma?

verses.original: הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀ אֵ֑ל כִּֽי־ תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯōw yiš·ma‘ ’êl kî- ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lāw ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him
verses.literalPt: Acaso, ouvirá Deus o clamor, quando lhe sobrevier a tribulação?

verses.original: אִם־ עַל־ שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל־ עֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘al- šad·day yiṯ·‘an·nāḡ yiq·rā ’ĕ·lō·w·ah bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ
verses.literal: Will he delight in the Almighty Will he call upon God at all times . . .
verses.literalPt: Deleitar-se-á no Todo-Poderoso e invocará a Deus em todo o tempo?

verses.original: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד־ אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־ שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·reh ’eṯ·ḵem bə·yaḏ- ’êl ’ă·šer ‘i·mō·ša- šad·dai lō ’ă·ḵa·ḥêḏ
verses.literal: I will instruct you in the power of God I will not conceal the ways of . . . the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Ensinar-vos-ei acerca das obras de Deus, E não ocultarei a mente do Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: הֵן־ אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה־ זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hên- ’at·tem kul·lə·ḵem ḥă·zî·ṯem wə·lām·māh- zeh he·ḇel teh·bā·lū
verses.literal: Surely all of you have seen it for yourselves Why then do you keep up this empty talk . . .
verses.literalPt: Eis que todos vós o conheceis. Por que, pois, vos entregais a juízos falsos?

verses.original: זֶ֤ה׀ חֵֽלֶק־ אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע׀ עִם־ אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zeh ḥê·leq- ’ā·ḏām rā·šā‘ ‘im- ’êl wə·na·ḥă·laṯ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm miš·šad·day yiq·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: This is the wicked man’s portion from God the heritage the ruthless receive from the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Esta é, a porção do iníquo da parte de Deus, e a herança que os opressores recebem do Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: אִם־ יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ־ חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yir·bū ḇā·nāw lə·mōw- ḥā·reḇ wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’āw lō yiś·bə·‘ū- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Though his sons are many they are destined for the sword and his offspring will never have enough food
verses.literalPt: Se seus filhos se multiplicarem, multiplicam-se para a espada; a sua prole não se fartará de pão.

verses.original: שְׂרִידוֹ בַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: śə·rī·ḏō bam·mā·weṯ yiq·qā·ḇê·rū wə·’al·mə·nō·ṯāw lō ṯiḇ·ke·nāh
verses.literal: His survivors will be buried by the plague and their widows will not weep for them
verses.literalPt: Os que ficarem deles na peste serão sepultados, e as suas viúvas não chorarão.

verses.original: אִם־ יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yiṣ·bōr ke·‘ā·p̄ār kā·sep̄ wə·ḵa·ḥō·mer yā·ḵîn mal·būš
verses.literal: Though he heaps up silver like dust and piles up a wardrobe like clay
verses.literalPt: Embora amontoe ele prata como pó e aparelhe vestidos como barro,

verses.original: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḵîn wə·ṣad·dîq yil·bāš wə·ḵe·sep̄ nā·qî ya·ḥă·lōq
verses.literal: what he lays up the righteous will wear and his silver will be divided by the innocent
verses.literalPt: ele pode aparelhá-los, mas o justo os vestirá, e o inocente repartirá a prata.

verses.original: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bā·nāh ḵā·‘āš bê·ṯōw ū·ḵə·suk·kāh ‘ā·śāh nō·ṣêr
verses.literal: The house he built is like a moth’s cocoon like a hut set up by a watchman
verses.literalPt: Edifica a sua casa como a traça e como a choça que o vigia faz.

verses.original: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šîr yiš·kaḇ wə·lō yê·’ā·sêp̄ ‘ê·nāw pā·qaḥ wə·’ê·nen·nū
verses.literal: He lies down wealthy but will do so no more . . . when he opens his eyes all is gone
verses.literalPt: Deita-se rico, porém não será recolhido à sepultura; abre os seus olhos, e já não é.

verses.original: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: taś·śî·ḡê·hū ḵam·ma·yim bal·lā·hō·wṯ lay·lāh gə·nā·ḇat·tū sū·p̄āh
verses.literal: Terrors overtake him like a flood a tempest sweeps him away in the night
verses.literalPt: Pavores o alcançam como águas, de noite, o arrebata a tempestade.

verses.original: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·’ê·hū qā·ḏîm wə·yê·laḵ wî·śā·‘ă·rê·hū mim·mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: The east wind carries him away and he is gone it sweeps him out of his place
verses.literalPt: O vento oriental leva-o, e ele se vai, e varre-o do seu lugar.

verses.original: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yaš·lêḵ ‘ā·lāw wə·lō yaḥ·mōl mî·yā·ḏōw bā·rō·w·aḥ yiḇ·rāḥ
verses.literal: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong . . . from its power
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus atirará contra ele, e não o poupará a ele, que quer fugir da sua mão a toda a pressa.

verses.original: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·pōq ‘ā·lê·mōw ḵap·pê·mōw wə·yiš·rōq ‘ā·lāw mim·mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: It claps its hands at him and hisses him out of his place
verses.literalPt: Os homens baterão palmas à sua queda e o afugentarão com assobios.
